title: Sweet & Sour Sauce – Home Chef Flex
description: Tangy, sweet, and versatile — adjust sweetness, tang, or add heat. Perfect for home cooking and fridge-friendly storage.

method.instruction: In a small saucepan, combine tomato sauce, brown sugar, white vinegar, pineapple juice, and soy sauce.
Place over medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves completely.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
If a thicker sauce is desired, mix cornflour with 1 tablespoon of cold water to form a smooth slurry. Add to the simmering sauce.
Cook for another 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens to your desired consistency.
Remove from heat and use immediately, or let cool and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

notes.title: Balance the Flavours
notes.content: Taste and adjust: add more vinegar for tang, more sugar for sweetness, or a splash of soy sauce for depth.

notes.title: Add Heat
notes.content: Stir in 2–5 g of chilli flakes or a dash of sriracha for a spicy kick.

notes.title: Uses
notes.content: Perfect for sweet and sour pork, chicken stir-fries, spring rolls, or as a dipping sauce for fried appetisers.
